system.description:
You summon a snake under your command that that originates from a location of your choice on your body. These snakes can follow a multitude of commands;

Shadow Snake Bite. Make a melee ninjutsu attack against a creature you can see up to 20 feet away. On a hit, you deal 2d8 Poison damage they must make a Strength saving throw, being Grappled by your snakes on a failed save. A Grappled creature remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, breaking the grapple on a success.

Snake Terrain. You can ignore difficult terrain if it originates from the ground, as your snakes helps you traverse the area.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage from Shadow Snake Bite by +1d8. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the number of creatures you can target with Shadow Snake Bite, by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the number of creatures you can target with Shadow Snake Bite, by +1.
